title: The 2026 playbook for sustainable service growth
summary: As labor rate increases approach a ceiling, sales tools and technician productivity will become the main levers to drive profitable growth for dealers. Trends across the three “fixed ops golden metrics” show that in some segments, increased effective labor rates were not able to outpace fewer hours per RO. The data shows that by using technology to streamline technician workflows, uncover additional repair opportunities, and maximize every customer interaction, dealers can build a more sustainable service operation in 2026.
